typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		MEMBER_LASTNAME as string,
		MEMBER_DISCHARGE_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_DATE_OF_DEATH as string,
		MEMBER_FIRSTNAME as string,
		MEMBER_MCO_PLAN_ID as string,
		MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_START_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_END_DATE as string,
		HHS_TO_MCO_FILE_SENT_DATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCDOJREPORTINGMEMBERDATA
OLESRCDOJREPORTINGMEMBERDATA derive(MEMBER_ID = MEMBER_ID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		GRC_MEMBER_MCO_PLAN_ID as string,
		GRC_MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_END_DATE as string,
		GRC_MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_START_DATE as string,
		GRC_MEMBER_DISCHARGE_DATE as string,
		GRC_HHS_TO_MCO_FILE_SENT_DATE as string,
		GRC_MEMBER_ID as string,
		GRC_MEMBER_LASTNAME as string,
		GRC_MEMBER_FIRSTNAME as string,
		GRC_MEMBER_DATE_OF_DEATH as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		GRC_MEMBER_MCO_PLAN_ID = MEMBER_MCO_PLAN_ID,
		GRC_MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_END_DATE = MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_END_DATE,
		GRC_MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_START_DATE = MEMBER_MCO_ASSIGNMENT_START_DATE,
		GRC_MEMBER_DISCHARGE_DATE = MEMBER_DISCHARGE_DATE,
		GRC_HHS_TO_MCO_FILE_SENT_DATE = HHS_TO_MCO_FILE_SENT_DATE,
		GRC_MEMBER_ID = MEMBER_ID,
		GRC_MEMBER_LASTNAME = MEMBER_LASTNAME,
		GRC_MEMBER_FIRSTNAME = MEMBER_FIRSTNAME,
		GRC_MEMBER_DATE_OF_DEATH = MEMBER_DATE_OF_DEATH)) ~> FFDSTHeaderFile
